Shallow-cross probation entries (heavy size-DOWN, NOT skip) still validating under trend-following, though today's risk-on rotation trimmed the staples names: BMY (0.13% cross, 50% unit) remains book leader at +10.19% on Day 14; GIS (0.29% cross, 75% unit) gave back to +1.36% on Day 16 as staples sold in the rally (was +5.67%); CAG (0.113% cross, 50% unit) round-tripped to ~0.00% on Day 3 (was +3.40%). Still ~3-4 samples; keep sizing down, do not upsize.
avoid: STACKED-FLAG entries (shallow cross + extended above EMA + thin liquidity together) -- RESOLVED as a SKIP, not a size-down: PDBC (0.15% cross + ~6.05% extended + thin liq, taken quarter-unit Jul 24) was the tightest-to-stop in the book and stopped out -2.40% on Day 3 (Jul 27). Distinguish from a SINGLE shallow-cross flag with no other strike (BMY/GIS/CAG), which remains a valid size-DOWN. Rule: one flag -> size down; two or more stacked -> skip.

Extended entries (price well above EMA-20 at entry) -- CONFIRMED LOSER: META entered Jul 15 at ~8.5% above EMA-20, peaked +2.83%, broke LOWER and stopped out at -8.04% (-$584.45) Jul 23. Firm rule: treat large above-EMA extension (>~6-8%) as a size-DOWN or wait-for-pullback; when it co-occurs with a shallow cross (as PDBC), SKIP outright. Repeatedly re-validated at scan time (skipped Jul 28/29/30 on this exact stacked signature: NOW, XLB).

Shallow EMA cross entries on earnings-adjacent names: TSLA (Jul 7 entry, 0.06% cross spread, earnings Jul 22) lost -4.78% on exit. Rule: SKIP (do not size down) when BOTH shallow cross spread (<0.5%) AND earnings within 14 days apply simultaneously.

Very shallow golden crosses (<0.1% EMA-20/60 spread): NVDA (0.07%), MDT (0.014%, skipped Jul 27), XLB (0.029%, skipped Jul 29 & Jul 30) are noise-level, high reversal risk -- skip on sight. BMY at 0.13% and CAG at 0.113% cleared this line, taken at half unit, and were green (CAG now flat on rotation), validating 0.1% as the skip floor.

Earnings-blackout holds ride to the hard stop with no discretionary exit: CMG (entered Jul 10, earnings blackout Jul 15-29) drifted to its 2xATR stop and filled automatically at -8.06% on Jul 22. Blackout policy working as intended -- record of realized blackout downside, not a rule change.

LEGACY intraday RSI buckets (informational, strategy retired): RSI 60-65 0/3, RSI 65-75 0/1, gap-up opens with RSI>60 -- all losers historically. Retained only as a record of why the intraday RSI approach was abandoned in favor of trend-following.
